verdict.rationale: cubic is an AI code-review product that generates fixes, so showing license or public-code matching references for AI-suggested code is a fair question for it. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions license detection, code-provenance checks, or matching against public code. Its reviews, codebase scans and analytics cover bugs, vulnerabilities and AI-authorship metrics, not licensing or public-code matches.

support.subject: As an engineering-lead, I can see license and public-code matching references for AI-suggested code
